description.en:
Aotsuki Ushio's family maintains a Shinto temple in Japan, where 500 years ago, his samurai ancestor battled a demon to a standstill, and eventually trapped him against a rock using a blessed spear called the "Beast Spear". While cleaning out the temple storage, Ushio accidentally unseals the chamber the demon, later named Tora by Ushio, was trapped in. Initially, Ushio wisely refuses to remove the spear pinning the monster down, as Tora unwisely makes the strategic blunder of mentioning that the first thing he would do upon being freed would be to devour Ushio; but Tora's unsealed presence attracts various demons to the premises, and Ushio is forced to free Tora in exchange for his help. The two later realize that they make a perfect team, despite the latter's reservations to eating the former.

description.en:
In a world where gods bestow special powers known as "Skills" upon individuals, young Leon, an aspiring adventurer, is saddled with an ability deemed worthless: "Alarm Clock." Despite its lowly status, Leon diligently works as an alarm clock for the townspeople, supporting his ailing sister. However, his life is marred by constant debt to the cruel nobleman Gideon.

One fateful day, Leon's seemingly useless "Alarm Clock" evolves, unlocking the ability to "Unseal." A golden coin he possesses transforms into the goddess of the sun, Solana, and Leon is thrust into an epic adventure to unravel the mysteries of the gods' seals. With his newfound power, Leon embarks on a quest to become the "Gentle Strongest," defying the odds and rewriting his destiny.
description.ja: 神様から与えられる特別な力〈スキル〉。冒険者を志す少年・リオンは、"外れスキル"と貶される『目覚まし』という能力しか持っていなかった。病弱な妹のために、朝早くから街の人々を起こす仕事をしているのだが、いじわるな貴族・ギデオンに借金を返すだけの日々……。そのとき、外れスキルのはずの『目覚まし』が進化し、『封印解除』が発動した！彼の持っていた金貨から太陽の女神・ソラーナが現れ、リオンは神々の封印を巡る冒険へと旅立つ。

Instead of slurping soup, though, he surrenders his meal to a manic girl who, unbeknownst to Keita, is a Mototsumitama, a guardian of the coexistence equilibrium. When his new acquaintance is attacked, Keita gets caught in the crossfire and loses an arm. Awakening from the shock of his injury, Keita finds himself back in his apartment… arm intact! But just whose arm is it?! Asking the strange girl raiding his refrigerator reveals only that Keita's life has become a great deal more complicated.

А несколько лет спустя Кейта встречает необычную девушку, которая очень любит рамен и которая кое-что знает про двойников. Но, как только она начала свой рассказ, как на неё напал странный человек в плаще. И началась драка, в ходе которой Кейта потерял свою левую руку. И он бы так и умер, если бы девушка не заключила с ним контракт, сутью которого является обмен рук. Кейта выжил, узнал, что девушку зовут Куро, что теперь их связывает контракт и что теперь его жизнь уже никогда не будет прежней.

Porém, antes da execução do ritual, a menina é salva por Kail Mursili, outro dos príncipes herdeiros. Agora, as vidas de Yuuri e Kail estão na mira da imperatriz, que fará de tudo para obter controle do império hitita. E é através dos olhos de Yuuri que presenciamos as sangrentas guerras e cruéis intrigas do antigo Oriente Médio, enquanto a garota luta pela sobrevivência e pelo seu crescente amor por Kail.

Horror manga artist. Some of his most notable works include *Tomie*, a series chronicling an immortal girl who drives her stricken admirers to madness; Spiral Into Horror Uzumaki, a three-volume series about a town obsessed with spirals; and *Gyo*, a two-volume story where fish are controlled by a strain of sentient bacteria called "the death stench." His other works include *Itou Junji Kyoufu Manga Collection*, a collection of different short stories including a series of stories named *Souichi's Journal of Delights* and *Itou Junji's Cat Diary: Yon & Mu*, a self-parody about him and his wife living in a house with two cats. Itou's work has developed a substantial cult following, with some deeming him a significant figure in recent horror iconography.

In 2006, Junji married Ishiguro Ayako (石黒亜矢子), a picture book artist. As of 2013, they have two children.

biography.en:
**Hirohiko Araki** (荒木 飛呂彦, born June 7, 1960) is a Japanese manga artist. He is best known for his long-running series JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, which was first published in Weekly Shōnen Jump in 1987 and has sold over 100 million copies as of 2016 in Japan alone.

Araki participated in the Junior Baseball Team in primary school and Kendo Club in middle school. He has a pair of twin younger sisters. Because he was often bullied by his sister, he would hide away to read manga. He liked manga when he was a child, so he wants to be a manga artist. His favorite works are Star of the Giants by Kajiwara Ikki , and Babel II by Yokoyama. Araki had the experience of shaking hands with Tezuka Osamu.

He likes western pop music, horror movies and Italy very much. We can see a lot of the above elements in his representative work JOJO.His painting style was influenced by Renaissance paintings, especially Michelangelo.

He gets up at 10 a.m. every day, draws a Name on Sunday, finishes the draft from Monday to Thursday, rests on Friday and Saturday, and doesn't stay up late. This work and rest lasted more than ten years . The work and rest of this law is influenced by the manga artist [Akimoto Osamu](https://mangadex.org/author/1cd79d33-68b3-4879-b67a-834055ef99eb/akimoto-osamu). Although he is over 50, his face does not show his old state. He is even joked by other manga artists and fans as "the younger he lives", "Immortality", "using corrugation or stone ghost face", "in fact, he is also a Stand, and his ability is that he will not grow old".

In the end, Ashley is granted temporary mage status by her mentor, the Secretary of the Ministry of Magic Education, but in exchange she is asked to educate an imprisoned young man with immense magical power that no one with magical power can even touch…?! A young man who has lived a solitary life and a mage with a reason. It's a great way to learn more about the history of the world.
